title: Add Application
description: Scaffold a new application. Supported types: flutter, angular, ionic.

name.description: Application name (kebab-case). Used as the directory name under apps/ and Nx project name.

dir.description: Folder under apps/ for the app (kebab-case names separated by "/", at most 3, e.g. legacy or legacy/web): the app goes to apps/<dir>/<name>.

cspConnectSrc.description: URL to pre-populate csp-allowlist.json connect-src (Angular only, e.g. https://api.example.com).

i18n.description: Locale codes to scaffold L10n ARB files for (e.g. ["en", "hi"]). Omit to skip L10n.

push.description: Push notification provider. 'fcm' scaffolds firebase_messaging dependency and init code.

deeplink.description: HTTPS domain for deep link scaffold (e.g. https://example.com). Omit to skip.

baseHref.description: Base href of the uat and prod release configurations (Angular/Ionic release target, Flutter build-web), e.g. /portal/.

port.description: Dev-server port (1024-65535). Default: the lowest free port from 4200 among the workspace's apps.

envLayout.description: Angular/Ionic env files: default (environment.ts for dev) or per-env (environment.dev|uat|prod.ts replacing a shared environments/environment.ts).

appId.description: Ionic only — Capacitor appId in reverse-DNS form (default: com.example.<name without dashes>).
